Title: Browser Spawning Shell Process
Description: Detects a web browser spawning command-line interpreters or scripting engines, which is a strong indicator of a drive-by download or browser exploit. This is rarely seen in normal operations and is a hallmark of malvertising and exploit kit delivery.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Browser extensions that legitimately spawn shells are extremely rare

Title: Suspicious Download-Execute Pattern
Description: Detects a file created in a temporary or user-writable directory followed by its execution within a short time window, a common pattern for malware delivered via malvertising or phishing.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Software updaters downloading and executing updates

Title: WMI Lateral Movement
Description: Detects WMI provider host (wmiprvse.exe) spawning unexpected child processes, which indicates WMI-based lateral movement or remote execution. Legitimate WMI activity typically spawns only management tools.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Enterprise management tools using WMI for remote administration

Title: Registry Run Key Persistence
Description: Detects modifications to Windows Run or RunOnce registry keys, a classic persistence mechanism used by nearly all malware families. Path-specific matching reduces false positives from legitimate startup entries.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Legitimate software installers adding startup entries

Title: Process Injection via Remote Thread
Description: Detects creation of remote threads across process boundaries, the core mechanism of process injection. This technique is used by advanced malware for defense evasion and credential theft.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Debugging tools and some security products
